messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired for service="inference-runtime-prod" severity=critical. Symptom=error-rate spike (5xx). PD incident: https://pagerduty.com/INC12345. Routing target: infra-analytics (escalation) — anyone oncall for runtime?

mira: wait why is this going to infra-analytics? that sounds wrong. infra-oncall should get this.

pagerduty-bot: note: service id changed 2h ago (service_name: inference-runtime -> inference-runtime-prod). Integration mapping still bound to old PD-service-id: svc_anal_legacy.

sam: @mira i'm on mobile, paging now. can someone ack in PD so we don't spam infra-analytics?

jonathan: acked in PD. i'm taking lead. quick check: are requests actually failing for hosted-api customers or is this internal flapping?

emily-platform: alerts show a sustained 12% 5xx increase across gpus-us-west for last 6m, most errors are Code=KVCacheMiss -> stacktrace points to recent runtime build 2024.05.02.

mira: ok we have two problems: 1) wrong PD routing target (legacy mapping) 2) runtime errors. i'm reassigning PD incident to infra-oncall and pushing a temporary rule to suppress further pages to analytics.

ops-bot: command executed: `pdctl incident assign INC12345 --service inference-runtime-prod --team infra-oncall`

mira: pdctl output: success. pages now routed to infra-oncall. sending note to infra-analytics to ignore noisy pages. @pagerduty-bot can you confirm no more pages will go to analytics?

pagerduty-bot: confirmed: escalation policy updated, previous binding (svc_anal_legacy) removed. New binding: svc_infra_oncall.

sam: thanks. jonathan, any quick mitigation for the KV cache errors?

jonathan: rolling back the runtime build is our fastest path. starting a canary rollback to build 2024.04.28 on one node pool now.

incident-bot: Canary rollback started on pool=gpu-us-west-a. Notifying tracing and monitoring.

emily-platform: after rollback, error rate on canary nodes dropped to baseline within 2 minutes. initiating wider rollback.

mira: good. please keep PD incident updated: adding postmortem tag and customer impact note.

sam: customer impact summary for PD incident: approx 50 failed requests from 7 customers over 12 minutes; transient increased latency for ~3200 requests, no data loss, non-authored telemetry only. tagging customers ops-team/top-accounts for outreach.

jonathan: rollback complete across pools. metrics back to normal. closing mitigation loop.

mira: follow-ups: 1) create a small change to PD integration scripts to prefer service id over service name to avoid rename breakages (ticket INF-4821). 2) run a PD-binding audit job to detect orphaned bindings (INF-4822). 3) add a unit test to the deploy pipeline to warn on service renames (INF-4823).

incident-bot: PD incident INC12345 status=resolved. Root cause: recent runtime build regression + PD integration mapping stale after service rename. Resolved by rollback and PD binding update.

mira: leaving notes for postmortem. closing thread once postmortem draft is created. :thumbsup:
